description: Plan for Storytime Advantage, the English program for Anuban 2 to P2 with a reading and phonics emphasis: four levels of 32 weeks, five scripted daily lessons, a phonics graph under the English domain, a weekly read-along book and song, a decodable per element, printed spaced review, benchmarks, the Chibi Sprouts digital twin, and a Primary catch-up module. MVP is Levels 1 and 2 in print with songs and books by QR. No code and no public date. Waits for Daniel's decisions S1 to S14.
deviation_notes: Created 2026-10-21 in the Storytime session after a planning discussion with Daniel. Daniel fixed the program shape (four levels, 32 weeks, 5 periods of 30 and 49 minutes, five scripts, printed spaced review, weekly book and song) and approved the Chibi Sprouts theme. The design document was produced by a Fable design subagent from the research and peer answers of 2026-10-21 (Workbooks, PR, Graph, Monorepo). Planning files only, committed on primary-parity-integration per Monorepo's instruction.
